scam.title: This SMS looks like fraud
scam.never: Never share your PIN or OTP with anyone.
scam.shareMessage: Warning: I received a fake SMS pretending to be {{sender}}. It asks you to {{asks}}. Do not reply, do not send money, do not share any code. Report scams to PTA: 0800-55055. - sent from HisaabKitaab AI
scam.senderGeneric: a bank or a government office
scam.asksDefault: send money or share private details

asks.secret: share your OTP, PIN or CNIC
asks.prize: pay money to claim a prize
asks.threat: act now or your account will be blocked
asks.job: pay money for a job or visa

reasons.fee: It asks you to pay a fee or send money first. Real money never needs a fee first.
reasons.secret: It asks for your OTP, PIN, CNIC or password. A real bank or office never asks for these by SMS.
reasons.bisp: It uses the BISP name. Real BISP messages come only from 8171.
reasons.prize: It says you won a prize. A real prize never asks you to pay or click.
reasons.wrong_transfer: It says money was sent by mistake and asks you to send it back. This is a common trick.
reasons.threat: It threatens to block your account unless you act now.
reasons.link: It has a suspicious link. Do not open it.
reasons.courier: It pretends to be a parcel or courier message and wants a fee or a link.
reasons.job: It offers a job or visa and asks for money.
